# User & Setup Guide

Step-by-step instructions for deploying, configuring, and using this asset.

## Prerequisites
Before installing or deploying, ensure your Salesforce environment meets the following requirements:
* Salesforce Edition: Enterprise, Unlimited, or Developer Org
* Required Features: (e.g., Digital Experiences, Agentforce, Flow Builder enabled)

## Installation & Deployment
Explain how to deploy this asset into an org:

```bash
# Example: Deploying source using Salesforce CLI
sf project deploy start --target-org MyDevOrg
